# Changelog

## 1.0.0

Pinned Atlassian's agent plugin at `352a02b05189e2a958a973867cc6eca365cb8fc3`, with the Atlassian MCP server's `/v2/mcp` endpoint and five self-contained skills: `capture-tasks-from-meeting-notes`, `jira-sprint-dashboard`, `search-company-knowledge`, `spec-to-backlog` and `triage-issue`.
